pages.text: Loot boxes are right-click containers earned through FTB Quests. Completing extra quest paths rewards a box.$(br2)$(bold)Iron (T1):$() 2-4 T1 tokens, flawed/chipped gems, Overworld boss materials, Common reforge token.$(br)$(bold)Steel (T2):$() 2-4 T2 tokens, normal/flawless gems, TF/Aether materials, Rare reforge token, 5% unique weapon.$(br)$(bold)T3:$() T3 tokens, flawless/perfect gems, Cataclysm materials, Epic reforge token.$(br)$(bold)T4:$() T4 tokens, perfect gems, Legendary reforge token.$(br)$(bold)Crucible:$() Mixed high-tier + guaranteed unique.$(br)$(bold)Mythic:$() Rift Shards, endgame materials.
